narrative.incident_description: The vulnerability DEMO-VULN-003 has been identified on asset HLT-PACS-01 (hostname pacs-01, IP 10.40.1.15, sector health). The installed software version is unknown and requires manual verification. No evidence of exploitation has been observed.
recommended_next_actions: Verify the scope by confirming the affected asset details and determining if the exposure is genuine.
Preserve all relevant system logs; CERT-In Directions require ICT system logs to be retained for 180 days.
Deploy the vendor-provided patch or apply appropriate mitigations, or otherwise restrict exposure until a patch is applied.
Conduct a hunt for any signs of exploitation; if exploitation is detected, reassess reportability as the 6-hour reporting window starts when the activity is noticed.
